id: # pipeline: divergences the pipeline's gate found (csrc/runtime/pipe_gate: each env's rows against test_snapshots' with play's view running beside the tick, and every device frame against the C renderer and play's own frame at the same tick)

cause: play's renderer hook (live_update_renderer) took the dials' surface test from view_dim, which follows a dimension change only after the tick, so at a respawn out of the End (and nether-fight-s1's death in the Nether) TextureClock and TextureCompass drew their Math.random off the surface where vanilla's theWorld is already the overworld: the client stream moved; play --check never ran the hook
repro: make -C csrc/runtime pipe-gate PRECS="cp-end-s1 nether-fight-s1" N=2 J=2

cause: play's renderer hook read the fog's light from view_world(), at the respawn tick still the Nether's server world, at the player's new overworld position: the read loaded (generated) a Nether chunk there and the server's entities moved (186 against 191 at row 117); it now reads the dimension the client world is in
repro: make -C csrc/runtime pipe-gate PRECS=nether-fight-s1 N=1 J=1

cause: the device renderer keeps meshes by (section slot, version) and the C renderer counted versions per renderer: after the return from the Nether (tick 818) the new renderer's versions restarted and the device drew a resident overworld mesh for a new section (5404 px at tick 821); versions are now a process-wide serial (raster.c live_mesh)
repro: make -C csrc/runtime pipe-gate PRECS=nether-trip2-s42 N=1 J=1

cause: play's renderer hook spent the clock's and compass's Math.random only for the dials the loaded texture animation held; when lane/rerender retired rendertick/anim_liquids (play's fallback) none loaded and off the surface the client stream moved (cp-nether-s1 row 2, end-arrival-s1 row 38); the dials now draw whatever the animation holds, as vanilla and the engine's cp_renderer_draws do
repro: make -C csrc/runtime pipe-gate PRECS="cp-nether-s1 end-arrival-s1" N=2 J=2
